quotes.title: Alpha Mensae
quotes.card: Alpha Mensae, also named Hoerikwaggo, is the brightest star in the constellation Mensa.
quotes.introduction: At a magnitude of 5.09, it is the dimmest lucida in the sky, and the second-faintest star labeled "alpha", after Alpha Octantis.
